svg.text: 435 nodes · 221 relationships · 418 implied labels, generated from the CGMES 3.0 RDFS vocabularies (GitHub entsoe/application-profiles-library, tag cgmes3.0). The main arrows are named by their relationship type; hover any arrow for its name and description, and cards link to the class in the RDFS vocabulary.
Topology, power flow and operation (TP, SSH, SV, OP, SC)
required: every source has one or more
every source has at most one
subtype: also carries the supertype's label

path.title: HAS_PCC_TERMINAL: Point of common coupling terminal for this converter DC side. It is typically the terminal on the power transformer (or switch) closest to the AC network. Each ACDCConverter has at most one Terminal. The inverse role is Terminal.ConverterDCSides: each Terminal has zero or more ACDCConverter.

HAS_DC_CONDUCTING_EQUIPMENT: A DC converter terminal belong to an DC converter. Each ACDCConverterDCTerminal has exactly one ACDCConverter. The inverse role is ACDCConverter.DCTerminals: each ACDCConverter has zero or more ACDCConverterDCTerminal.

HAS_BUS_NAME_MARKER: The bus name marker used to name the bus (topological node). Each ACDCTerminal has at most one BusNameMarker. The inverse role is BusNameMarker.Terminal: each BusNameMarker has one or more ACDCTerminal.
HAS_LIMIT_SET: The set of limits. Each AccumulatorLimit has exactly one AccumulatorLimitSet. The inverse role is AccumulatorLimitSet.Limits: each AccumulatorLimitSet has one or more AccumulatorLimit.

HAS_MEASUREMENTS: The Measurements using the LimitSet. Each AccumulatorLimitSet has one or more Accumulator. The inverse role is Accumulator.LimitSets: each Accumulator has zero or more AccumulatorLimitSet.

HAS_ACCUMULATOR_VALUE: The accumulator value that is reset by the command. Each AccumulatorReset has exactly one AccumulatorValue. The inverse role is AccumulatorValue.AccumulatorReset: each AccumulatorValue has at most one AccumulatorReset.

HAS_ACCUMULATOR: Measurement to which this value is connected. Each AccumulatorValue has exactly one Accumulator. The inverse role is Accumulator.AccumulatorValues: each Accumulator has zero or more AccumulatorValue.

HAS_ANALOG_VALUE: The MeasurementValue that is controlled. Each AnalogControl has exactly one AnalogValue. The inverse role is AnalogValue.AnalogControl: each AnalogValue has at most one AnalogControl.
HAS_LIMIT_SET: The set of limits. Each AnalogLimit has exactly one AnalogLimitSet. The inverse role is AnalogLimitSet.Limits: each AnalogLimitSet has zero or more AnalogLimit.
HAS_MEASUREMENTS: The Measurements using the LimitSet. Each AnalogLimitSet has one or more Analog. The inverse role is Analog.LimitSets: each Analog has zero or more AnalogLimitSet.
HAS_ANALOG: Measurement to which this value is connected. Each AnalogValue has exactly one Analog. The inverse role is Analog.AnalogValues: each Analog has zero or more AnalogValue.

HAS_ASYNCHRONOUS_MACHINE: Asynchronous machine to which this asynchronous machine dynamics model applies. Each AsynchronousMachineDynamics has exactly one AsynchronousMachine. The inverse role is AsynchronousMachine.AsynchronousMachineDynamics: each AsynchronousMachine has at most one AsynchronousMachineDynamics.

HAS_TERMINAL: The Terminal at the equipment where the AuxiliaryEquipment is attached. Each AuxiliaryEquipment has exactly one Terminal. The inverse role is Terminal.AuxiliaryEquipment: each Terminal has zero or more AuxiliaryEquipment.
HAS_VOLTAGE_LEVEL: The voltage level containing this bay. Each Bay has exactly one VoltageLevel. The inverse role is VoltageLevel.Bays: each VoltageLevel has zero or more Bay.

HAS_REPORTING_GROUP: The reporting group to which this bus name marker belongs. Each BusNameMarker has at most one ReportingGroup. The inverse role is ReportingGroup.BusNameMarker: each ReportingGroup has zero or more BusNameMarker.

HAS_CS_CONVERTER: Current source converter to which current source converter dynamics model applies. Each CSCDynamics has exactly one CsConverter. The inverse role is CsConverter.CSCDynamics: each CsConverter has at most one CSCDynamics.
HAS_AC_LINE_SEGMENT: The line segment to which the clamp is connected. Each Clamp has exactly one ACLineSegment. The inverse role is ACLineSegment.Clamp: each ACLineSegment has zero or more Clamp.
HAS_DISCRETE_VALUE: The MeasurementValue that is controlled. Each Command has exactly one DiscreteValue. The inverse role is DiscreteValue.Command: each DiscreteValue has at most one Command.

HAS_VALUE_ALIAS_SET: The ValueAliasSet used for translation of a Control value to a name. Each Command has at most one ValueAliasSet. The inverse role is ValueAliasSet.Commands: each ValueAliasSet has zero or more Command.

HAS_BASE_VOLTAGE: Base voltage of this conducting equipment. Use only when there is no voltage level container used and only one base voltage applies. For example, not used for transformers. Each ConductingEquipment has at most one BaseVoltage. The inverse role is BaseVoltage.ConductingEquipment: each BaseVoltage has zero or more ConductingEquipment.
HAS_LOAD_GROUP: Group of this ConformLoad. Each ConformLoad has exactly one ConformLoadGroup. The inverse role is ConformLoadGroup.EnergyConsumers: each ConformLoadGroup has one or more ConformLoad.

HAS_CONFORM_LOAD_GROUP: The ConformLoadGroup where the ConformLoadSchedule belongs. Each ConformLoadSchedule has exactly one ConformLoadGroup. The inverse role is ConformLoadGroup.ConformLoadSchedules: each ConformLoadGroup has zero or more ConformLoadSchedule.

HAS_CONNECTIVITY_NODE_CONTAINER: Container of this connectivity node. Each ConnectivityNode has exactly one ConnectivityNodeContainer. The inverse role is ConnectivityNodeContainer.ConnectivityNodes: each ConnectivityNodeContainer has zero or more ConnectivityNode.

HAS_TOPOLOGICAL_NODE: The topological node to which this connectivity node is assigned. May depend on the current state of switches in the network. Each ConnectivityNode has exactly one TopologicalNode. The inverse role is TopologicalNode.ConnectivityNodes: each TopologicalNode has zero or more ConnectivityNode.

HAS_POWER_SYSTEM_RESOURCE: Regulating device governed by this control output. Each Control has at most one PowerSystemResource. The inverse role is PowerSystemResource.Controls: each PowerSystemResource has zero or more Control.

HAS_ENERGY_AREA: The energy area that is forecast from this control area specification. Each ControlArea has exactly one EnergyArea. The inverse role is EnergyArea.ControlArea: each EnergyArea has at most one ControlArea.

HAS_CONTROL_AREA: The parent control area for the generating unit specifications. Each ControlAreaGeneratingUnit has exactly one ControlArea. The inverse role is ControlArea.ControlAreaGeneratingUnit: each ControlArea has zero or more ControlAreaGeneratingUnit.

HAS_GENERATING_UNIT: The generating unit specified for this control area. Note that a control area should include a GeneratingUnit only once. Each ControlAreaGeneratingUnit has exactly one GeneratingUnit. The inverse role is GeneratingUnit.ControlAreaGeneratingUnit: each GeneratingUnit has zero or more ControlAreaGeneratingUnit.

HAS_HIGH_PRESSURE_SYNCHRONOUS_MACHINE_DYNAMICS: High-pressure synchronous machine with which this cross-compound turbine governor is associated. Each CrossCompoundTurbineGovernorDynamics has exactly one SynchronousMachineDynamics. The inverse role is SynchronousMachineDynamics.CrossCompoundTurbineGovernorDyanmics: each SynchronousMachineDynamics has at most one CrossCompoundTurbineGovernorDynamics.

HAS_LOW_PRESSURE_SYNCHRONOUS_MACHINE_DYNAMICS: Low-pressure synchronous machine with which this cross-compound turbine governor is associated. Each CrossCompoundTurbineGovernorDynamics has exactly one SynchronousMachineDynamics. The inverse role is SynchronousMachineDynamics.CrossCompoundTurbineGovernorDynamics: each SynchronousMachineDynamics has at most one CrossCompoundTurbineGovernorDynamics.
HAS_CURVE: The curve of this curve data point. Each CurveData has exactly one Curve. The inverse role is Curve.CurveDatas: each Curve has one or more CurveData.
HAS_AC_LINE_SEGMENT: The line segment to which the cut is applied. Each Cut has exactly one ACLineSegment. The inverse role is ACLineSegment.Cut: each ACLineSegment has zero or more Cut.

HAS_DC_NODE: The DC connectivity node to which this DC base terminal connects with zero impedance. Each DCBaseTerminal has at most one DCNode. The inverse role is DCNode.DCTerminals: each DCNode has zero or more DCBaseTerminal.

HAS_DC_TOPOLOGICAL_NODE: See association end Terminal.TopologicalNode. Each DCBaseTerminal has exactly one DCTopologicalNode. The inverse role is DCTopologicalNode.DCTerminals: each DCTopologicalNode has zero or more DCBaseTerminal.

HAS_SUBSTATION: The containing substation of the DC converter unit. Each DCConverterUnit has at most one Substation. The inverse role is Substation.DCConverterUnit: each Substation has zero or more DCConverterUnit.

HAS_REGION: The SubGeographicalRegion containing the DC line. Each DCLine has at most one SubGeographicalRegion. The inverse role is SubGeographicalRegion.DCLines: each SubGeographicalRegion has zero or more DCLine.

HAS_DC_EQUIPMENT_CONTAINER: The DC container for the DC nodes. Each DCNode has exactly one DCEquipmentContainer. The inverse role is DCEquipmentContainer.DCNodes: each DCEquipmentContainer has zero or more DCNode.

HAS_DC_TOPOLOGICAL_NODE: The DC topological node to which this DC connectivity node is assigned. May depend on the current state of switches in the network. Each DCNode has exactly one DCTopologicalNode. The inverse role is DCTopologicalNode.DCNodes: each DCTopologicalNode has zero or more DCNode.

HAS_DC_CONDUCTING_EQUIPMENT: An DC terminal belong to a DC conducting equipment. Each DCTerminal has exactly one DCConductingEquipment. The inverse role is DCConductingEquipment.DCTerminals: each DCConductingEquipment has zero or more DCTerminal.

HAS_DC_TOPOLOGICAL_NODES: The DC topological nodes in a DC topological island. Each DCTopologicalIsland has one or more DCTopologicalNode. The inverse role is DCTopologicalNode.DCTopologicalIsland: each DCTopologicalNode has at most one DCTopologicalIsland.

HAS_DC_EQUIPMENT_CONTAINER: The connectivity node container to which the topological node belongs. Each DCTopologicalNode has exactly one DCEquipmentContainer. The inverse role is DCEquipmentContainer.DCTopologicalNode: each DCEquipmentContainer has zero or more DCTopologicalNode.
HAS_DIAGRAM_STYLE: A Diagram may have a DiagramStyle. Each Diagram has at most one DiagramStyle. The inverse role is DiagramStyle.Diagram: each DiagramStyle has zero or more Diagram.
HAS_DIAGRAM: A diagram object is part of a diagram. Each DiagramObject has exactly one Diagram. The inverse role is Diagram.DiagramElements: each Diagram has zero or more DiagramObject.

HAS_DIAGRAM_OBJECT_STYLE: A diagram object has a style associated that provides a reference for the style used in the originating system. Each DiagramObject has at most one DiagramObjectStyle. The inverse role is DiagramObjectStyle.StyledObjects: each DiagramObjectStyle has zero or more DiagramObject.

HAS_IDENTIFIED_OBJECT: The domain object to which this diagram object is associated. Each DiagramObject has at most one IdentifiedObject. The inverse role is IdentifiedObject.DiagramObjects: each IdentifiedObject has zero or more DiagramObject.

HAS_DIAGRAM_OBJECT: The diagram object with which the points are associated. Each DiagramObjectPoint has exactly one DiagramObject. The inverse role is DiagramObject.DiagramObjectPoints: each DiagramObject has zero or more DiagramObjectPoint.

HAS_DIAGRAM_OBJECT_GLUE_POINT: The 'glue' point to which this point is associated. Each DiagramObjectPoint has at most one DiagramObjectGluePoint. The inverse role is DiagramObjectGluePoint.DiagramObjectPoints: each DiagramObjectGluePoint has between 2 and * DiagramObjectPoint.

HAS_EXCITATION_SYSTEM_DYNAMICS: Excitation system model with which this discontinuous excitation control model is associated. Each DiscontinuousExcitationControlDynamics has exactly one ExcitationSystemDynamics. The inverse role is ExcitationSystemDynamics.DiscontinuousExcitationControlDynamics: each ExcitationSystemDynamics has at most one DiscontinuousExcitationControlDynamics.

HAS_VALUE_ALIAS_SET: The ValueAliasSet used for translation of a MeasurementValue.value to a name. Each Discrete has at most one ValueAliasSet. The inverse role is ValueAliasSet.Discretes: each ValueAliasSet has zero or more Discrete.
HAS_DISCRETE: Measurement to which this value is connected. Each DiscreteValue has exactly one Discrete. The inverse role is Discrete.DiscreteValues: each Discrete has zero or more DiscreteValue.

HAS_LOAD_DYNAMICS: Load dynamics model used to describe dynamic behaviour of this energy consumer. Each EnergyConsumer has at most one LoadDynamics. The inverse role is LoadDynamics.EnergyConsumer: each LoadDynamics has zero or more EnergyConsumer.

HAS_LOAD_RESPONSE: The load response characteristic of this load. If missing, this load is assumed to be constant power. Each EnergyConsumer has at most one LoadResponseCharacteristic. The inverse role is LoadResponseCharacteristic.EnergyConsumer: each LoadResponseCharacteristic has zero or more EnergyConsumer.

HAS_ENERGY_SCHEDULING_TYPE: Energy Scheduling Type of an Energy Source. Each EnergySource has at most one EnergySchedulingType. The inverse role is EnergySchedulingType.EnergySource: each EnergySchedulingType has zero or more EnergySource.

HAS_EQUIPMENT_CONTAINER: Container of this equipment. Each Equipment has at most one EquipmentContainer. The inverse role is EquipmentContainer.Equipments: each EquipmentContainer has zero or more Equipment.

HAS_EQUIVALENT_NETWORK: The equivalent where the reduced model belongs. Each EquivalentEquipment has at most one EquivalentNetwork. The inverse role is EquivalentNetwork.EquivalentEquipments: each EquivalentNetwork has zero or more EquivalentEquipment.

HAS_REACTIVE_CAPABILITY_CURVE: The reactive capability curve used by this equivalent injection. Each EquivalentInjection has at most one ReactiveCapabilityCurve. The inverse role is ReactiveCapabilityCurve.EquivalentInjection: each ReactiveCapabilityCurve has zero or more EquivalentInjection.

HAS_SYNCHRONOUS_MACHINE_DYNAMICS: Synchronous machine model with which this excitation system model is associated. Each ExcitationSystemDynamics has exactly one SynchronousMachineDynamics. The inverse role is SynchronousMachineDynamics.ExcitationSystemDynamics: each SynchronousMachineDynamics has at most one ExcitationSystemDynamics.

HAS_THERMAL_GENERATING_UNIT: A thermal generating unit may have one or more fossil fuels. Each FossilFuel has exactly one ThermalGeneratingUnit. The inverse role is ThermalGeneratingUnit.FossilFuels: each ThermalGeneratingUnit has zero or more FossilFuel.

HAS_SYNCHRONOUS_MACHINE_DYNAMICS: Standard synchronous machine out of which current flow is being compensated for. Each GenICompensationForGenJ has exactly one SynchronousMachineDynamics. The inverse role is SynchronousMachineDynamics.GenICompensationForGenJ: each SynchronousMachineDynamics has zero or more GenICompensationForGenJ.

HAS_VCOMP_IEEE_TYPE2: The standard IEEE type 2 voltage compensator of this compensation. Each GenICompensationForGenJ has exactly one VCompIEEEType2. The inverse role is VCompIEEEType2.GenICompensationForGenJ: each VCompIEEEType2 has between 2 and * GenICompensationForGenJ.

HAS_GENERATING_UNIT: A generating unit may have a gross active power to net active power curve, describing the losses and auxiliary power requirements of the unit. Each GrossToNetActivePowerCurve has exactly one GeneratingUnit. The inverse role is GeneratingUnit.GrossToNetActivePowerCurves: each GeneratingUnit has zero or more GrossToNetActivePowerCurve.

HAS_HYDRO_POWER_PLANT: The hydro generating unit belongs to a hydro power plant. Each HydroGeneratingUnit has at most one HydroPowerPlant. The inverse role is HydroPowerPlant.HydroGeneratingUnits: each HydroPowerPlant has zero or more HydroGeneratingUnit.

HAS_HYDRO_POWER_PLANT: The hydro pump may be a member of a pumped storage plant or a pump for distributing water. Each HydroPump has at most one HydroPowerPlant. The inverse role is HydroPowerPlant.HydroPumps: each HydroPowerPlant has zero or more HydroPump.

HAS_ROTATING_MACHINE: The synchronous machine drives the turbine which moves the water from a low elevation to a higher elevation. The direction of machine rotation for pumping may or may not be the same as for generating. Each HydroPump has exactly one RotatingMachine. The inverse role is RotatingMachine.HydroPump: each RotatingMachine has at most one HydroPump.

HAS_REGION: The sub-geographical region of the line. Each Line has at most one SubGeographicalRegion. The inverse role is SubGeographicalRegion.Lines: each SubGeographicalRegion has zero or more Line.
HAS_SUB_LOAD_AREA: The SubLoadArea where the Loadgroup belongs. Each LoadGroup has exactly one SubLoadArea. The inverse role is SubLoadArea.LoadGroups: each SubLoadArea has one or more LoadGroup.

HAS_LOAD_AGGREGATE: Aggregate load to which this aggregate motor (dynamic) load belongs. Each LoadMotor has exactly one LoadAggregate. The inverse role is LoadAggregate.LoadMotor: each LoadAggregate has at most one LoadMotor.

HAS_LOAD_AGGREGATE: Aggregate load to which this aggregate static load belongs. Each LoadStatic has exactly one LoadAggregate. The inverse role is LoadAggregate.LoadStatic: each LoadAggregate has at most one LoadStatic.

HAS_COORDINATE_SYSTEM: Coordinate system used to describe position points of this location. Each Location has exactly one CoordinateSystem. The inverse role is CoordinateSystem.Locations: each CoordinateSystem has zero or more Location.

HAS_POWER_SYSTEM_RESOURCES: All power system resources at this location. Each Location has exactly one PowerSystemResource. The inverse role is PowerSystemResource.Location: each PowerSystemResource has at most one Location.

HAS_POWER_SYSTEM_RESOURCE: The power system resource that contains the measurement. Each Measurement has exactly one PowerSystemResource. The inverse role is PowerSystemResource.Measurements: each PowerSystemResource has zero or more Measurement.

HAS_TERMINAL: One or more measurements may be associated with a terminal in the network. Each Measurement has at most one ACDCTerminal. The inverse role is ACDCTerminal.Measurements: each ACDCTerminal has zero or more Measurement.

HAS_MEASUREMENT_VALUE_SOURCE: A reference to the type of source that updates the MeasurementValue, e.g. SCADA, CCLink, manual, etc. User conventions for the names of sources are contained in the introduction to IEC 61970-301. Each MeasurementValue has exactly one MeasurementValueSource. The inverse role is MeasurementValueSource.MeasurementValues: each MeasurementValueSource has zero or more MeasurementValue.

HAS_MEASUREMENT_VALUE: A MeasurementValue has a MeasurementValueQuality associated with it. Each MeasurementValueQuality has exactly one MeasurementValue. The inverse role is MeasurementValue.MeasurementValueQuality: each MeasurementValue has at most one MeasurementValueQuality.

HAS_ASYNCHRONOUS_MACHINE_DYNAMICS: Asynchronous machine model with which this mechanical load model is associated. MechanicalLoadDynamics shall have either an association to SynchronousMachineDynamics or to AsynchronousMachineDynamics. Each MechanicalLoadDynamics has at most one AsynchronousMachineDynamics. The inverse role is AsynchronousMachineDynamics.MechanicalLoadDynamics: each AsynchronousMachineDynamics has at most one MechanicalLoadDynamics.

HAS_SYNCHRONOUS_MACHINE_DYNAMICS: Synchronous machine model with which this mechanical load model is associated. MechanicalLoadDynamics shall have either an association to SynchronousMachineDynamics or AsynchronousMachineDyanmics. Each MechanicalLoadDynamics has at most one SynchronousMachineDynamics. The inverse role is SynchronousMachineDynamics.MechanicalLoadDynamics: each SynchronousMachineDynamics has at most one MechanicalLoadDynamics.

HAS_FIRST_TERMINAL: The starting terminal for the calculation of distances along the first branch of the mutual coupling. Normally MutualCoupling would only be used for terminals of AC line segments. The first and second terminals of a mutual coupling should point to different AC line segments. Each MutualCoupling has exactly one Terminal. The inverse role is Terminal.HasFirstMutualCoupling: each Terminal has zero or more MutualCoupling.

HAS_SECOND_TERMINAL: The starting terminal for the calculation of distances along the second branch of the mutual coupling. Each MutualCoupling has exactly one Terminal. The inverse role is Terminal.HasSecondMutualCoupling: each Terminal has zero or more MutualCoupling.

HAS_LOAD_GROUP: Group of this ConformLoad. Each NonConformLoad has exactly one NonConformLoadGroup. The inverse role is NonConformLoadGroup.EnergyConsumers: each NonConformLoadGroup has one or more NonConformLoad.

HAS_NON_CONFORM_LOAD_GROUP: The NonConformLoadGroup where the NonConformLoadSchedule belongs. Each NonConformLoadSchedule has exactly one NonConformLoadGroup. The inverse role is NonConformLoadGroup.NonConformLoadSchedules: each NonConformLoadGroup has zero or more NonConformLoadSchedule.

HAS_NONLINEAR_SHUNT_COMPENSATOR: Non-linear shunt compensator owning this point. Each NonlinearShuntCompensatorPoint has exactly one NonlinearShuntCompensator. The inverse role is NonlinearShuntCompensator.NonlinearShuntCompensatorPoints: each NonlinearShuntCompensator has one or more NonlinearShuntCompensatorPoint.

HAS_OPERATIONAL_LIMIT_SET: The limit set to which the limit values belong. Each OperationalLimit has exactly one OperationalLimitSet. The inverse role is OperationalLimitSet.OperationalLimitValue: each OperationalLimitSet has zero or more OperationalLimit.

HAS_OPERATIONAL_LIMIT_TYPE: The limit type associated with this limit. Each OperationalLimit has exactly one OperationalLimitType. The inverse role is OperationalLimitType.OperationalLimit: each OperationalLimitType has zero or more OperationalLimit.

HAS_EQUIPMENT: The equipment to which the limit set applies. Each OperationalLimitSet has at most one Equipment. The inverse role is Equipment.OperationalLimitSet: each Equipment has zero or more OperationalLimitSet.

HAS_TERMINAL: The terminal where the operational limit set apply. Each OperationalLimitSet has exactly one ACDCTerminal. The inverse role is ACDCTerminal.OperationalLimitSet: each ACDCTerminal has zero or more OperationalLimitSet.

HAS_EXCITATION_SYSTEM_DYNAMICS: Excitation system model with which this overexcitation limiter model is associated. Each OverexcitationLimiterDynamics has exactly one ExcitationSystemDynamics. The inverse role is ExcitationSystemDynamics.OverexcitationLimiterDynamics: each ExcitationSystemDynamics has at most one OverexcitationLimiterDynamics.

HAS_EXCITATION_SYSTEM_DYNAMICS: Excitation system model with which this power actor or VAr controller type 1 model is associated. Each PFVArControllerType1Dynamics has exactly one ExcitationSystemDynamics. The inverse role is ExcitationSystemDynamics.PFVArControllerType1Dynamics: each ExcitationSystemDynamics has at most one PFVArControllerType1Dynamics.

HAS_EXCITATION_SYSTEM_DYNAMICS: Excitation system model with which this power factor or VAr controller type 2 is associated. Each PFVArControllerType2Dynamics has exactly one ExcitationSystemDynamics. The inverse role is ExcitationSystemDynamics.PFVArControllerType2Dynamics: each ExcitationSystemDynamics has at most one PFVArControllerType2Dynamics.

HAS_TRANSFORMER_END: Transformer end to which this phase tap changer belongs. Each PhaseTapChanger has exactly one TransformerEnd. The inverse role is TransformerEnd.PhaseTapChanger: each TransformerEnd has at most one PhaseTapChanger.

HAS_PHASE_TAP_CHANGER_TABLE: The table of this point. Each PhaseTapChangerTablePoint has exactly one PhaseTapChangerTable. The inverse role is PhaseTapChangerTable.PhaseTapChangerTablePoint: each PhaseTapChangerTable has one or more PhaseTapChangerTablePoint.

HAS_PHASE_TAP_CHANGER_TABLE: The phase tap changer table for this phase tap changer. Each PhaseTapChangerTabular has exactly one PhaseTapChangerTable. The inverse role is PhaseTapChangerTable.PhaseTapChangerTabular: each PhaseTapChangerTable has zero or more PhaseTapChangerTabular.
HAS_LOCATION: Location described by this position point. Each PositionPoint has exactly one Location. The inverse role is Location.PositionPoints: each Location has zero or more PositionPoint.

HAS_POWER_ELECTRONICS_UNIT: An AC network connection may have several power electronics units connecting through it. Each PowerElectronicsConnection has at most one PowerElectronicsUnit. The inverse role is PowerElectronicsUnit.PowerElectronicsConnection: each PowerElectronicsUnit has exactly one PowerElectronicsConnection.

HAS_EXCITATION_SYSTEM_DYNAMICS: Excitation system model with which this power system stabilizer model is associated. Each PowerSystemStabilizerDynamics has exactly one ExcitationSystemDynamics. The inverse role is ExcitationSystemDynamics.PowerSystemStabilizerDynamics: each ExcitationSystemDynamics has at most one PowerSystemStabilizerDynamics.

HAS_POWER_TRANSFORMER: The power transformer of this power transformer end. Each PowerTransformerEnd has exactly one PowerTransformer. The inverse role is PowerTransformer.PowerTransformerEnd: each PowerTransformer has zero or more PowerTransformerEnd.

HAS_ASYNCHRONOUS_MACHINE_USER_DEFINED: Proprietary user-defined model with which this parameter is associated. Each ProprietaryParameterDynamics has at most one AsynchronousMachineUserDefined. The inverse role is AsynchronousMachineUserDefined.ProprietaryParameterDynamics: each AsynchronousMachineUserDefined has zero or more ProprietaryParameterDynamics.

HAS_CSC_USER_DEFINED: Proprietary user-defined model with which this parameter is associated. Each ProprietaryParameterDynamics has at most one CSCUserDefined. The inverse role is CSCUserDefined.ProprietaryParameterDynamics: each CSCUserDefined has zero or more ProprietaryParameterDynamics.

HAS_DISCONTINUOUS_EXCITATION_CONTROL_USER_DEFINED: Proprietary user-defined model with which this parameter is associated. Each ProprietaryParameterDynamics has at most one DiscontinuousExcitationControlUserDefined. The inverse role is DiscontinuousExcitationControlUserDefined.ProprietaryParameterDynamics: each DiscontinuousExcitationControlUserDefined has zero or more ProprietaryParameterDynamics.

HAS_EXCITATION_SYSTEM_USER_DEFINED: Proprietary user-defined model with which this parameter is associated. Each ProprietaryParameterDynamics has at most one ExcitationSystemUserDefined. The inverse role is ExcitationSystemUserDefined.ProprietaryParameterDynamics: each ExcitationSystemUserDefined has zero or more ProprietaryParameterDynamics.

HAS_LOAD_USER_DEFINED: Proprietary user-defined model with which this parameter is associated. Each ProprietaryParameterDynamics has at most one LoadUserDefined. The inverse role is LoadUserDefined.ProprietaryParameterDynamics: each LoadUserDefined has zero or more ProprietaryParameterDynamics.

HAS_MECHANICAL_LOAD_USER_DEFINED: Proprietary user-defined model with which this parameter is associated. Each ProprietaryParameterDynamics has at most one MechanicalLoadUserDefined. The inverse role is MechanicalLoadUserDefined.ProprietaryParameterDynamics: each MechanicalLoadUserDefined has zero or more ProprietaryParameterDynamics.

HAS_OVEREXCITATION_LIMITER_USER_DEFINED: Proprietary user-defined model with which this parameter is associated. Each ProprietaryParameterDynamics has at most one OverexcitationLimiterUserDefined. The inverse role is OverexcitationLimiterUserDefined.ProprietaryParameterDynamics: each OverexcitationLimiterUserDefined has zero or more ProprietaryParameterDynamics.

HAS_PFV_AR_CONTROLLER_TYPE1_USER_DEFINED: Proprietary user-defined model with which this parameter is associated. Each ProprietaryParameterDynamics has at most one PFVArControllerType1UserDefined. The inverse role is PFVArControllerType1UserDefined.ProprietaryParameterDynamics: each PFVArControllerType1UserDefined has zero or more ProprietaryParameterDynamics.

HAS_PFV_AR_CONTROLLER_TYPE2_USER_DEFINED: Proprietary user-defined model with which this parameter is associated. Each ProprietaryParameterDynamics has at most one PFVArControllerType2UserDefined. The inverse role is PFVArControllerType2UserDefined.ProprietaryParameterDynamics: each PFVArControllerType2UserDefined has zero or more ProprietaryParameterDynamics.

HAS_POWER_SYSTEM_STABILIZER_USER_DEFINED: Proprietary user-defined model with which this parameter is associated. Each ProprietaryParameterDynamics has at most one PowerSystemStabilizerUserDefined. The inverse role is PowerSystemStabilizerUserDefined.ProprietaryParameterDynamics: each PowerSystemStabilizerUserDefined has zero or more ProprietaryParameterDynamics.

HAS_SVC_USER_DEFINED: Proprietary user-defined model with which this parameter is associated. Each ProprietaryParameterDynamics has at most one SVCUserDefined. The inverse role is SVCUserDefined.ProprietaryParameterDynamics: each SVCUserDefined has zero or more ProprietaryParameterDynamics.

HAS_SYNCHRONOUS_MACHINE_USER_DEFINED: Proprietary user-defined model with which this parameter is associated. Each ProprietaryParameterDynamics has at most one SynchronousMachineUserDefined. The inverse role is SynchronousMachineUserDefined.ProprietaryParameterDynamics: each SynchronousMachineUserDefined has zero or more ProprietaryParameterDynamics.

HAS_TURBINE_GOVERNOR_USER_DEFINED: Proprietary user-defined model with which this parameter is associated. Each ProprietaryParameterDynamics has at most one TurbineGovernorUserDefined. The inverse role is TurbineGovernorUserDefined.ProprietaryParameterDynamics: each TurbineGovernorUserDefined has zero or more ProprietaryParameterDynamics.

HAS_TURBINE_LOAD_CONTROLLER_USER_DEFINED: Proprietary user-defined model with which this parameter is associated. Each ProprietaryParameterDynamics has at most one TurbineLoadControllerUserDefined. The inverse role is TurbineLoadControllerUserDefined.ProprietaryParameterDynamics: each TurbineLoadControllerUserDefined has zero or more ProprietaryParameterDynamics.

HAS_UNDEREXCITATION_LIMITER_USER_DEFINED: Proprietary user-defined model with which this parameter is associated. Each ProprietaryParameterDynamics has at most one UnderexcitationLimiterUserDefined. The inverse role is UnderexcitationLimiterUserDefined.ProprietaryParameterDynamics: each UnderexcitationLimiterUserDefined has zero or more ProprietaryParameterDynamics.

HAS_VSC_USER_DEFINED: Proprietary user-defined model with which this parameter is associated. Each ProprietaryParameterDynamics has at most one VSCUserDefined. The inverse role is VSCUserDefined.ProprietaryParameterDynamics: each VSCUserDefined has zero or more ProprietaryParameterDynamics.

HAS_VOLTAGE_ADJUSTER_USER_DEFINED: Proprietary user-defined model with which this parameter is associated. Each ProprietaryParameterDynamics has at most one VoltageAdjusterUserDefined. The inverse role is VoltageAdjusterUserDefined.ProprietaryParameterDynamics: each VoltageAdjusterUserDefined has zero or more ProprietaryParameterDynamics.

HAS_VOLTAGE_COMPENSATOR_USER_DEFINED: Proprietary user-defined model with which this parameter is associated. Each ProprietaryParameterDynamics has at most one VoltageCompensatorUserDefined. The inverse role is VoltageCompensatorUserDefined.ProprietaryParameterDynamics: each VoltageCompensatorUserDefined has zero or more ProprietaryParameterDynamics.

HAS_WIND_PLANT_USER_DEFINED: Proprietary user-defined model with which this parameter is associated. Each ProprietaryParameterDynamics has at most one WindPlantUserDefined. The inverse role is WindPlantUserDefined.ProprietaryParameterDynamics: each WindPlantUserDefined has zero or more ProprietaryParameterDynamics.

HAS_WIND_TYPE1OR2_USER_DEFINED: Proprietary user-defined model with which this parameter is associated. Each ProprietaryParameterDynamics has at most one WindType1or2UserDefined. The inverse role is WindType1or2UserDefined.ProprietaryParameterDynamics: each WindType1or2UserDefined has zero or more ProprietaryParameterDynamics.

HAS_WIND_TYPE3OR4_USER_DEFINED: Proprietary user-defined model with which this parameter is associated. Each ProprietaryParameterDynamics has at most one WindType3or4UserDefined. The inverse role is WindType3or4UserDefined.ProprietaryParameterDynamics: each WindType3or4UserDefined has zero or more ProprietaryParameterDynamics.

HAS_VALUE_ALIAS_SET: The ValueAliasSet used for translation of a Control value to a name. Each RaiseLowerCommand has at most one ValueAliasSet. The inverse role is ValueAliasSet.RaiseLowerCommands: each ValueAliasSet has zero or more RaiseLowerCommand.

HAS_RATIO_TAP_CHANGER_TABLE: The tap ratio table for this ratio tap changer. Each RatioTapChanger has at most one RatioTapChangerTable. The inverse role is RatioTapChangerTable.RatioTapChanger: each RatioTapChangerTable has zero or more RatioTapChanger.

HAS_TRANSFORMER_END: Transformer end to which this ratio tap changer belongs. Each RatioTapChanger has exactly one TransformerEnd. The inverse role is TransformerEnd.RatioTapChanger: each TransformerEnd has at most one RatioTapChanger.

HAS_RATIO_TAP_CHANGER_TABLE: Table of this point. Each RatioTapChangerTablePoint has exactly one RatioTapChangerTable. The inverse role is RatioTapChangerTable.RatioTapChangerTablePoint: each RatioTapChangerTable has one or more RatioTapChangerTablePoint.

HAS_INTERVAL_SCHEDULE: Regular interval schedule containing this time point. Each RegularTimePoint has exactly one RegularIntervalSchedule. The inverse role is RegularIntervalSchedule.TimePoints: each RegularIntervalSchedule has one or more RegularTimePoint.

HAS_REGULATING_CONTROL: The regulating control scheme in which this equipment participates. Each RegulatingCondEq has at most one RegulatingControl. The inverse role is RegulatingControl.RegulatingCondEq: each RegulatingControl has zero or more RegulatingCondEq.

HAS_TERMINAL: The terminal associated with this regulating control. The terminal is associated instead of a node, since the terminal could connect into either a topological node or a connectivity node. Sometimes it is useful to model regulation at a terminal of a bus bar object. Each RegulatingControl has exactly one Terminal. The inverse role is Terminal.RegulatingControl: each Terminal has zero or more RegulatingControl.

HAS_REGULATING_CONTROL: Regulating controls that have this schedule. Each RegulationSchedule has exactly one RegulatingControl. The inverse role is RegulatingControl.RegulationSchedule: each RegulatingControl has zero or more RegulationSchedule.

HAS_DISCONTINUOUS_EXCITATION_CONTROL_DYNAMICS: Discontinuous excitation control model using this remote input signal. Each RemoteInputSignal has at most one DiscontinuousExcitationControlDynamics. The inverse role is DiscontinuousExcitationControlDynamics.RemoteInputSignal: each DiscontinuousExcitationControlDynamics has at most one RemoteInputSignal.

HAS_PFV_AR_CONTROLLER_TYPE1_DYNAMICS: Power factor or VAr controller type 1 model using this remote input signal. Each RemoteInputSignal has at most one PFVArControllerType1Dynamics. The inverse role is PFVArControllerType1Dynamics.RemoteInputSignal: each PFVArControllerType1Dynamics has at most one RemoteInputSignal.

HAS_POWER_SYSTEM_STABILIZER_DYNAMICS: Power system stabilizer model using this remote input signal. Each RemoteInputSignal has at most one PowerSystemStabilizerDynamics. The inverse role is PowerSystemStabilizerDynamics.RemoteInputSignal: each PowerSystemStabilizerDynamics has zero or more RemoteInputSignal.

HAS_TERMINAL: Remote terminal with which this input signal is associated. Each RemoteInputSignal has exactly one Terminal. The inverse role is Terminal.RemoteInputSignal: each Terminal has zero or more RemoteInputSignal.

HAS_UNDEREXCITATION_LIMITER_DYNAMICS: Underexcitation limiter model using this remote input signal. Each RemoteInputSignal has at most one UnderexcitationLimiterDynamics. The inverse role is UnderexcitationLimiterDynamics.RemoteInputSignal: each UnderexcitationLimiterDynamics has at most one RemoteInputSignal.

HAS_VOLTAGE_COMPENSATOR_DYNAMICS: Voltage compensator model using this remote input signal. Each RemoteInputSignal has at most one VoltageCompensatorDynamics. The inverse role is VoltageCompensatorDynamics.RemoteInputSignal: each VoltageCompensatorDynamics has at most one RemoteInputSignal.

HAS_GENERATING_UNIT: A synchronous machine may operate as a generator and as such becomes a member of a generating unit. Each RotatingMachine has at most one GeneratingUnit. The inverse role is GeneratingUnit.RotatingMachine: each GeneratingUnit has one or more RotatingMachine.
HAS_DAY_TYPE: DayType for the Schedule. Each SeasonDayTypeSchedule has exactly one DayType. The inverse role is DayType.SeasonDayTypeSchedules: each DayType has zero or more SeasonDayTypeSchedule.
HAS_SEASON: Season for the Schedule. Each SeasonDayTypeSchedule has exactly one Season. The inverse role is Season.SeasonDayTypeSchedules: each Season has zero or more SeasonDayTypeSchedule.

HAS_STATIC_VAR_COMPENSATOR: Static Var Compensator to which Static Var Compensator dynamics model applies. Each StaticVarCompensatorDynamics has exactly one StaticVarCompensator. The inverse role is StaticVarCompensator.StaticVarCompensatorDynamics: each StaticVarCompensator has at most one StaticVarCompensatorDynamics.

HAS_STRING_MEASUREMENT: Measurement to which this value is connected. Each StringMeasurementValue has exactly one StringMeasurement. The inverse role is StringMeasurement.StringMeasurementValues: each StringMeasurement has zero or more StringMeasurementValue.

HAS_REGION: The geographical region which this sub-geographical region is within. Each SubGeographicalRegion has exactly one GeographicalRegion. The inverse role is GeographicalRegion.Regions: each GeographicalRegion has zero or more SubGeographicalRegion.
HAS_LOAD_AREA: The LoadArea where the SubLoadArea belongs. Each SubLoadArea has exactly one LoadArea. The inverse role is LoadArea.SubLoadAreas: each LoadArea has one or more SubLoadArea.

HAS_REGION: The SubGeographicalRegion containing the substation. Each Substation has exactly one SubGeographicalRegion. The inverse role is SubGeographicalRegion.Substations: each SubGeographicalRegion has zero or more Substation.

HAS_TOPOLOGICAL_NODE: The topological node associated with the flow injection state variable. Each SvInjection has exactly one TopologicalNode. The inverse role is TopologicalNode.SvInjection: each TopologicalNode has at most one SvInjection.

HAS_TERMINAL: The terminal associated with the power flow state variable. Each SvPowerFlow has exactly one Terminal. The inverse role is Terminal.SvPowerFlow: each Terminal has at most one SvPowerFlow.

HAS_SHUNT_COMPENSATOR: The shunt compensator for which the state applies. Each SvShuntCompensatorSections has exactly one ShuntCompensator. The inverse role is ShuntCompensator.SvShuntCompensatorSections: each ShuntCompensator has at most one SvShuntCompensatorSections.

HAS_CONDUCTING_EQUIPMENT: The conducting equipment associated with the status state variable. Each SvStatus has exactly one ConductingEquipment. The inverse role is ConductingEquipment.SvStatus: each ConductingEquipment has at most one SvStatus.
HAS_SWITCH: The switch associated with the switch state. Each SvSwitch has exactly one Switch. The inverse role is Switch.SvSwitch: each Switch has zero or more SvSwitch.
HAS_TAP_CHANGER: The tap changer associated with the tap step state. Each SvTapStep has exactly one TapChanger. The inverse role is TapChanger.SvTapStep: each TapChanger has at most one SvTapStep.

HAS_TOPOLOGICAL_NODE: The topological node associated with the voltage state. Each SvVoltage has exactly one TopologicalNode. The inverse role is TopologicalNode.SvVoltage: each TopologicalNode has at most one SvVoltage.
HAS_SWITCH: A SwitchSchedule is associated with a Switch. Each SwitchSchedule has exactly one Switch. The inverse role is Switch.SwitchSchedules: each Switch has zero or more SwitchSchedule.

HAS_INITIAL_REACTIVE_CAPABILITY_CURVE: The default reactive capability curve for use by a synchronous machine. Each SynchronousMachine has at most one ReactiveCapabilityCurve. The inverse role is ReactiveCapabilityCurve.InitiallyUsedBySynchronousMachines: each ReactiveCapabilityCurve has one or more SynchronousMachine.

HAS_SYNCHRONOUS_MACHINE: Synchronous machine to which synchronous machine dynamics model applies. Each SynchronousMachineDynamics has exactly one SynchronousMachine. The inverse role is SynchronousMachine.SynchronousMachineDynamics: each SynchronousMachine has at most one SynchronousMachineDynamics.

HAS_TAP_CHANGER_CONTROL: The regulating control scheme in which this tap changer participates. Each TapChanger has at most one TapChangerControl. The inverse role is TapChangerControl.TapChanger: each TapChangerControl has one or more TapChanger.
HAS_TAP_CHANGER: A TapSchedule is associated with a TapChanger. Each TapSchedule has exactly one TapChanger. The inverse role is TapChanger.TapSchedules: each TapChanger has zero or more TapSchedule.

HAS_CONDUCTING_EQUIPMENT: The conducting equipment of the terminal. Conducting equipment have terminals that may be connected to other conducting equipment terminals via connectivity nodes or topological nodes. Each Terminal has exactly one ConductingEquipment. The inverse role is ConductingEquipment.Terminals: each ConductingEquipment has zero or more Terminal.

HAS_CONNECTIVITY_NODE: The connectivity node to which this terminal connects with zero impedance. Each Terminal has at most one ConnectivityNode. The inverse role is ConnectivityNode.Terminals: each ConnectivityNode has zero or more Terminal.

HAS_TOPOLOGICAL_NODE: The topological node associated with the terminal. This can be used as an alternative to the connectivity node path to topological node, thus making it unnecessary to model connectivity nodes in some cases. Note that the if connectivity nodes are in the model, this association would probably not be used as an input specification. Each Terminal has at most one TopologicalNode. The inverse role is TopologicalNode.Terminal: each TopologicalNode has one or more Terminal.

HAS_CAES_PLANT: A thermal generating unit may be a member of a compressed air energy storage plant. Each ThermalGeneratingUnit has at most one CAESPlant. The inverse role is CAESPlant.ThermalGeneratingUnit: each CAESPlant has at most one ThermalGeneratingUnit.

HAS_COGENERATION_PLANT: A thermal generating unit may be a member of a cogeneration plant. Each ThermalGeneratingUnit has at most one CogenerationPlant. The inverse role is CogenerationPlant.ThermalGeneratingUnits: each CogenerationPlant has zero or more ThermalGeneratingUnit.

HAS_COMBINED_CYCLE_PLANT: A thermal generating unit may be a member of a combined cycle plant. Each ThermalGeneratingUnit has at most one CombinedCyclePlant. The inverse role is CombinedCyclePlant.ThermalGeneratingUnits: each CombinedCyclePlant has zero or more ThermalGeneratingUnit.
HAS_CONTROL_AREA: The control area of the tie flows. Each TieFlow has exactly one ControlArea. The inverse role is ControlArea.TieFlow: each ControlArea has zero or more TieFlow.
HAS_TERMINAL: The terminal to which this tie flow belongs. Each TieFlow has exactly one Terminal. The inverse role is Terminal.TieFlow: each Terminal has between 0 and 2 TieFlow.

HAS_ANGLE_REF_TOPOLOGICAL_NODE: The angle reference for the island. Normally there is one TopologicalNode that is selected as the angle reference for each island. Other reference schemes exist, so the association is typically optional. Each TopologicalIsland has exactly one TopologicalNode. The inverse role is TopologicalNode.AngleRefTopologicalIsland: each TopologicalNode has at most one TopologicalIsland.

HAS_TOPOLOGICAL_NODES: A topological node belongs to a topological island. Each TopologicalIsland has one or more TopologicalNode. The inverse role is TopologicalNode.TopologicalIsland: each TopologicalNode has at most one TopologicalIsland.

HAS_BASE_VOLTAGE: The base voltage of the topological node. Each TopologicalNode has exactly one BaseVoltage. The inverse role is BaseVoltage.TopologicalNode: each BaseVoltage has zero or more TopologicalNode.

HAS_CONNECTIVITY_NODE_CONTAINER: The connectivity node container to which the topological node belongs. Each TopologicalNode has exactly one ConnectivityNodeContainer. The inverse role is ConnectivityNodeContainer.TopologicalNode: each ConnectivityNodeContainer has zero or more TopologicalNode.

HAS_REPORTING_GROUP: The reporting group to which the topological node belongs. Each TopologicalNode has at most one ReportingGroup. The inverse role is ReportingGroup.TopologicalNode: each ReportingGroup has zero or more TopologicalNode.

HAS_BASE_VOLTAGE: Base voltage of the transformer end. This is essential for PU calculation. Each TransformerEnd has exactly one BaseVoltage. The inverse role is BaseVoltage.TransformerEnds: each BaseVoltage has zero or more TransformerEnd.

HAS_TERMINAL: Terminal of the power transformer to which this transformer end belongs. Each TransformerEnd has exactly one Terminal. The inverse role is Terminal.TransformerEnd: each Terminal has zero or more TransformerEnd.

HAS_ASYNCHRONOUS_MACHINE_DYNAMICS: Asynchronous machine model with which this turbine-governor model is associated. TurbineGovernorDynamics shall have either an association to SynchronousMachineDynamics or to AsynchronousMachineDynamics. Each TurbineGovernorDynamics has at most one AsynchronousMachineDynamics. The inverse role is AsynchronousMachineDynamics.TurbineGovernorDynamics: each AsynchronousMachineDynamics has at most one TurbineGovernorDynamics.

HAS_SYNCHRONOUS_MACHINE_DYNAMICS: Synchronous machine model with which this turbine-governor model is associated. TurbineGovernorDynamics shall have either an association to SynchronousMachineDynamics or to AsynchronousMachineDynamics. Each TurbineGovernorDynamics has at most one SynchronousMachineDynamics. The inverse role is SynchronousMachineDynamics.TurbineGovernorDynamics: each SynchronousMachineDynamics has zero or more TurbineGovernorDynamics.

HAS_TURBINE_GOVERNOR_DYNAMICS: Turbine-governor controlled by this turbine load controller. Each TurbineLoadControllerDynamics has exactly one TurbineGovernorDynamics. The inverse role is TurbineGovernorDynamics.TurbineLoadControllerDynamics: each TurbineGovernorDynamics has at most one TurbineLoadControllerDynamics.

HAS_EXCITATION_SYSTEM_DYNAMICS: Excitation system model with which this underexcitation limiter model is associated. Each UnderexcitationLimiterDynamics has exactly one ExcitationSystemDynamics. The inverse role is ExcitationSystemDynamics.UnderexcitationLimiterDynamics: each ExcitationSystemDynamics has at most one UnderexcitationLimiterDynamics.

HAS_VS_CONVERTER: Voltage source converter to which voltage source converter dynamics model applies. Each VSCDynamics has exactly one VsConverter. The inverse role is VsConverter.VSCDynamics: each VsConverter has at most one VSCDynamics.

HAS_VALUE_ALIAS_SET: The ValueAliasSet having the ValueToAlias mappings. Each ValueToAlias has exactly one ValueAliasSet. The inverse role is ValueAliasSet.Values: each ValueAliasSet has one or more ValueToAlias.

HAS_VISIBLE_OBJECTS: A visibility layer can contain one or more diagram objects. Each VisibilityLayer has one or more DiagramObject. The inverse role is DiagramObject.VisibilityLayers: each DiagramObject has zero or more VisibilityLayer.

HAS_PFV_AR_CONTROLLER_TYPE1_DYNAMICS: Power factor or VAr controller type 1 model with which this voltage adjuster is associated. Each VoltageAdjusterDynamics has exactly one PFVArControllerType1Dynamics. The inverse role is PFVArControllerType1Dynamics.VoltageAdjusterDynamics: each PFVArControllerType1Dynamics has at most one VoltageAdjusterDynamics.

HAS_EXCITATION_SYSTEM_DYNAMICS: Excitation system model with which this voltage compensator is associated. Each VoltageCompensatorDynamics has exactly one ExcitationSystemDynamics. The inverse role is ExcitationSystemDynamics.VoltageCompensatorDynamics: each ExcitationSystemDynamics has exactly one VoltageCompensatorDynamics.

HAS_BASE_VOLTAGE: The base voltage used for all equipment within the voltage level. Each VoltageLevel has exactly one BaseVoltage. The inverse role is BaseVoltage.VoltageLevel: each BaseVoltage has zero or more VoltageLevel.
HAS_SUBSTATION: The substation of the voltage level. Each VoltageLevel has exactly one Substation. The inverse role is Substation.VoltageLevels: each Substation has zero or more VoltageLevel.

HAS_CAPABILITY_CURVE: Capability curve of this converter. Each VsConverter has at most one VsCapabilityCurve. The inverse role is VsCapabilityCurve.VsConverterDCSides: each VsCapabilityCurve has zero or more VsConverter.

HAS_WIND_CONT_CURR_LIM_IEC: The current control limitation model with which this wind dynamics lookup table is associated. Each WindDynamicsLookupTable has at most one WindContCurrLimIEC. The inverse role is WindContCurrLimIEC.WindDynamicsLookupTable: each WindContCurrLimIEC has one or more WindDynamicsLookupTable.

HAS_WIND_CONT_P_TYPE3_IEC: The P control type 3 model with which this wind dynamics lookup table is associated. Each WindDynamicsLookupTable has at most one WindContPType3IEC. The inverse role is WindContPType3IEC.WindDynamicsLookupTable: each WindContPType3IEC has one or more WindDynamicsLookupTable.

HAS_WIND_CONT_QPQU_LIM_IEC: The QP and QU limitation model with which this wind dynamics lookup table is associated. Each WindDynamicsLookupTable has at most one WindContQPQULimIEC. The inverse role is WindContQPQULimIEC.WindDynamicsLookupTable: each WindContQPQULimIEC has one or more WindDynamicsLookupTable.

HAS_WIND_CONT_ROTOR_RIEC: The rotor resistance control model with which this wind dynamics lookup table is associated. Each WindDynamicsLookupTable has at most one WindContRotorRIEC. The inverse role is WindContRotorRIEC.WindDynamicsLookupTable: each WindContRotorRIEC has one or more WindDynamicsLookupTable.

HAS_WIND_GEN_TYPE3B_IEC: The generator type 3B model with which this wind dynamics lookup table is associated. Each WindDynamicsLookupTable has at most one WindGenType3bIEC. The inverse role is WindGenType3bIEC.WindDynamicsLookupTable: each WindGenType3bIEC has one or more WindDynamicsLookupTable.

HAS_WIND_PITCH_CONT_POWER_IEC: The pitch control power model with which this wind dynamics lookup table is associated. Each WindDynamicsLookupTable has at most one WindPitchContPowerIEC. The inverse role is WindPitchContPowerIEC.WindDynamicsLookupTable: each WindPitchContPowerIEC has one or more WindDynamicsLookupTable.

HAS_WIND_PLANT_FREQ_PCONTROL_IEC: The frequency and active power wind plant control model with which this wind dynamics lookup table is associated. Each WindDynamicsLookupTable has at most one WindPlantFreqPcontrolIEC. The inverse role is WindPlantFreqPcontrolIEC.WindDynamicsLookupTable: each WindPlantFreqPcontrolIEC has one or more WindDynamicsLookupTable.

HAS_WIND_PLANT_REACTIVE_CONTROL_IEC: The voltage and reactive power wind plant control model with which this wind dynamics lookup table is associated. Each WindDynamicsLookupTable has at most one WindPlantReactiveControlIEC. The inverse role is WindPlantReactiveControlIEC.WindDynamicsLookupTable: each WindPlantReactiveControlIEC has one or more WindDynamicsLookupTable.

HAS_WIND_PROTECTION_IEC: The grid protection model with which this wind dynamics lookup table is associated. Each WindDynamicsLookupTable has at most one WindProtectionIEC. The inverse role is WindProtectionIEC.WindDynamicsLookupTable: each WindProtectionIEC has one or more WindDynamicsLookupTable.

HAS_WIND_AERO_CONST_IEC: Wind aerodynamic model associated with this wind turbine type 1A model. Each WindGenTurbineType1aIEC has exactly one WindAeroConstIEC. The inverse role is WindAeroConstIEC.WindGenTurbineType1aIEC: each WindAeroConstIEC has exactly one WindGenTurbineType1aIEC.

HAS_WIND_PITCH_CONT_POWER_IEC: Pitch control power model associated with this wind turbine type 1B model. Each WindGenTurbineType1bIEC has exactly one WindPitchContPowerIEC. The inverse role is WindPitchContPowerIEC.WindGenTurbineType1bIEC: each WindPitchContPowerIEC has at most one WindGenTurbineType1bIEC.

HAS_WIND_CONT_ROTOR_RIEC: Wind control rotor resistance model associated with wind turbine type 2 model. Each WindGenTurbineType2IEC has exactly one WindContRotorRIEC. The inverse role is WindContRotorRIEC.WindGenTurbineType2IEC: each WindContRotorRIEC has exactly one WindGenTurbineType2IEC.

HAS_WIND_PITCH_CONT_POWER_IEC: Pitch control power model associated with this wind turbine type 2 model. Each WindGenTurbineType2IEC has exactly one WindPitchContPowerIEC. The inverse role is WindPitchContPowerIEC.WindGenTurbineType2IEC: each WindPitchContPowerIEC has at most one WindGenTurbineType2IEC.

HAS_REMOTE_INPUT_SIGNAL: The remote signal with which this power plant is associated. Each WindPlantDynamics has at most one RemoteInputSignal. The inverse role is RemoteInputSignal.WindPlantDynamics: each RemoteInputSignal has at most one WindPlantDynamics.

HAS_WIND_PLANT_FREQ_PCONTROL_IEC: Wind plant frequency and active power control model associated with this wind plant. Each WindPlantIEC has exactly one WindPlantFreqPcontrolIEC. The inverse role is WindPlantFreqPcontrolIEC.WindPlantIEC: each WindPlantFreqPcontrolIEC has exactly one WindPlantIEC.

HAS_WIND_PLANT_REACTIVE_CONTROL_IEC: Wind plant model with which this wind reactive control is associated. Each WindPlantIEC has exactly one WindPlantReactiveControlIEC. The inverse role is WindPlantReactiveControlIEC.WindPlantIEC: each WindPlantReactiveControlIEC has exactly one WindPlantIEC.

HAS_ASYNCHRONOUS_MACHINE_DYNAMICS: Asynchronous machine model with which this wind generator type 1 or type 2 model is associated. Each WindTurbineType1or2Dynamics has exactly one AsynchronousMachineDynamics. The inverse role is AsynchronousMachineDynamics.WindTurbineType1or2Dynamics: each AsynchronousMachineDynamics has at most one WindTurbineType1or2Dynamics.

HAS_REMOTE_INPUT_SIGNAL: Remote input signal used by this wind generator type 1 or type 2 model. Each WindTurbineType1or2Dynamics has at most one RemoteInputSignal. The inverse role is RemoteInputSignal.WindTurbineType1or2Dynamics: each RemoteInputSignal has at most one WindTurbineType1or2Dynamics.

HAS_WIND_MECH_IEC: Wind mechanical model associated with this wind generator type 1 or type 2 model. Each WindTurbineType1or2IEC has exactly one WindMechIEC. The inverse role is WindMechIEC.WindTurbineType1or2IEC: each WindMechIEC has at most one WindTurbineType1or2IEC.

HAS_WIND_PROTECTION_IEC: Wind turbune protection model associated with this wind generator type 1 or type 2 model. Each WindTurbineType1or2IEC has exactly one WindProtectionIEC. The inverse role is WindProtectionIEC.WindTurbineType1or2IEC: each WindProtectionIEC has at most one WindTurbineType1or2IEC.

HAS_WIND_AERO_ONE_DIM_IEC: Wind aerodynamic model associated with this wind generator type 3 model. Each WindTurbineType3IEC has at most one WindAeroOneDimIEC. The inverse role is WindAeroOneDimIEC.WindTurbineType3IEC: each WindAeroOneDimIEC has exactly one WindTurbineType3IEC.

HAS_WIND_AERO_TWO_DIM_IEC: Wind aerodynamic model associated with this wind turbine type 3 model. Each WindTurbineType3IEC has at most one WindAeroTwoDimIEC. The inverse role is WindAeroTwoDimIEC.WindTurbineType3IEC: each WindAeroTwoDimIEC has exactly one WindTurbineType3IEC.

HAS_WIND_CONT_P_TYPE3_IEC: Wind control P type 3 model associated with this wind turbine type 3 model. Each WindTurbineType3IEC has exactly one WindContPType3IEC. The inverse role is WindContPType3IEC.WindTurbineType3IEC: each WindContPType3IEC has exactly one WindTurbineType3IEC.

HAS_WIND_CONT_PITCH_ANGLE_IEC: Wind control pitch angle model associated with this wind turbine type 3. Each WindTurbineType3IEC has exactly one WindContPitchAngleIEC. The inverse role is WindContPitchAngleIEC.WindTurbineType3IEC: each WindContPitchAngleIEC has exactly one WindTurbineType3IEC.

HAS_WIND_GEN_TYPE3_IEC: Wind generator type 3 model associated with this wind turbine type 3 model. Each WindTurbineType3IEC has at most one WindGenType3IEC. The inverse role is WindGenType3IEC.WindTurbineType3IEC: each WindGenType3IEC has at most one WindTurbineType3IEC.

HAS_WIND_MECH_IEC: Wind mechanical model associated with this wind turbine type 3 model. Each WindTurbineType3IEC has exactly one WindMechIEC. The inverse role is WindMechIEC.WindTurbineType3IEC: each WindMechIEC has at most one WindTurbineType3IEC.

HAS_POWER_ELECTRONICS_CONNECTION: The power electronics connection associated with this wind turbine type 3 or type 4 dynamics model. Each WindTurbineType3or4Dynamics has exactly one PowerElectronicsConnection. The inverse role is PowerElectronicsConnection.WindTurbineType3or4Dynamics: each PowerElectronicsConnection has at most one WindTurbineType3or4Dynamics.

HAS_REMOTE_INPUT_SIGNAL: Remote input signal used by these wind turbine type 3 or type 4 models. Each WindTurbineType3or4Dynamics has at most one RemoteInputSignal. The inverse role is RemoteInputSignal.WindTurbineType3or4Dynamics: each RemoteInputSignal has at most one WindTurbineType3or4Dynamics.

HAS_WIND_PLANT_DYNAMICS: The wind plant with which the wind turbines type 3 or type 4 are associated. Each WindTurbineType3or4Dynamics has at most one WindPlantDynamics. The inverse role is WindPlantDynamics.WindTurbineType3or4Dynamics: each WindPlantDynamics has one or more WindTurbineType3or4Dynamics.

HAS_W_IND_CONT_QIEC: Wind control Q model associated with this wind turbine type 3 or type 4 model. Each WindTurbineType3or4IEC has exactly one WindContQIEC. The inverse role is WindContQIEC.WindTurbineType3or4IEC: each WindContQIEC has exactly one WindTurbineType3or4IEC.

HAS_WIND_CONT_CURR_LIM_IEC: Wind control current limitation model associated with this wind turbine type 3 or type 4 model. Each WindTurbineType3or4IEC has exactly one WindContCurrLimIEC. The inverse role is WindContCurrLimIEC.WindTurbineType3or4IEC: each WindContCurrLimIEC has exactly one WindTurbineType3or4IEC.

HAS_WIND_CONT_Q_LIM_IEC: Constant Q limitation model associated with this wind generator type 3 or type 4 model. Each WindTurbineType3or4IEC has at most one WindContQLimIEC. The inverse role is WindContQLimIEC.WindTurbineType3or4IEC: each WindContQLimIEC has at most one WindTurbineType3or4IEC.

HAS_WIND_CONT_QPQU_LIM_IEC: QP and QU limitation model associated with this wind generator type 3 or type 4 model. Each WindTurbineType3or4IEC has at most one WindContQPQULimIEC. The inverse role is WindContQPQULimIEC.WindTurbineType3or4IEC: each WindContQPQULimIEC has at most one WindTurbineType3or4IEC.

HAS_WIND_PROTECTION_IEC: Wind turbune protection model associated with this wind generator type 3 or type 4 model. Each WindTurbineType3or4IEC has exactly one WindProtectionIEC. The inverse role is WindProtectionIEC.WindTurbineType3or4IEC: each WindProtectionIEC has at most one WindTurbineType3or4IEC.

HAS_WIND_REF_FRAME_ROT_IEC: Reference frame rotation model associated with this wind turbine type 3 or type 4 model. Each WindTurbineType3or4IEC has exactly one WindRefFrameRotIEC. The inverse role is WindRefFrameRotIEC.WindTurbineType3or4IEC: each WindRefFrameRotIEC has exactly one WindTurbineType3or4IEC.

HAS_WIND_GEN_TYPE3A_IEC: Wind generator type 3A model associated with this wind turbine type 4 model. Each WindTurbineType4IEC has at most one WindGenType3aIEC. The inverse role is WindGenType3aIEC.WindTurbineType4IEC: each WindGenType3aIEC has at most one WindTurbineType4IEC.

HAS_WIND_CONT_P_TYPE4A_IEC: Wind control P type 4A model associated with this wind turbine type 4A model. Each WindTurbineType4aIEC has exactly one WindContPType4aIEC. The inverse role is WindContPType4aIEC.WindTurbineType4aIEC: each WindContPType4aIEC has exactly one WindTurbineType4aIEC.

HAS_WIND_GEN_TYPE4_IEC: Wind generator type 4 model associated with this wind turbine type 4A model. Each WindTurbineType4aIEC has at most one WindGenType4IEC. The inverse role is WindGenType4IEC.WindTurbineType4aIEC: each WindGenType4IEC has at most one WindTurbineType4aIEC.

HAS_WIND_CONT_P_TYPE4B_IEC: Wind control P type 4B model associated with this wind turbine type 4B model. Each WindTurbineType4bIEC has exactly one WindContPType4bIEC. The inverse role is WindContPType4bIEC.WindTurbineType4bIEC: each WindContPType4bIEC has exactly one WindTurbineType4bIEC.

HAS_WIND_GEN_TYPE4_IEC: Wind generator type 4 model associated with this wind turbine type 4B model. Each WindTurbineType4bIEC has at most one WindGenType4IEC. The inverse role is WindGenType4IEC.WindTurbineType4bIEC: each WindGenType4IEC has at most one WindTurbineType4bIEC.

HAS_WIND_MECH_IEC: Wind mechanical model associated with this wind turbine type 4B model. Each WindTurbineType4bIEC has exactly one WindMechIEC. The inverse role is WindMechIEC.WindTurbineType4bIEC: each WindMechIEC has at most one WindTurbineType4bIEC.

HAS_CONNECTIVITY_NODE: The connectivity node that is designated as a boundary point. Each BoundaryPoint has exactly one ConnectivityNode. The inverse role is ConnectivityNode.BoundaryPoint: each ConnectivityNode has at most one BoundaryPoint.

HAS_SOLAR_POWER_PLANT: A solar power plant may have solar generating units. Each SolarGeneratingUnit has at most one SolarPowerPlant. The inverse role is SolarPowerPlant.SolarGeneratingUnits: each SolarPowerPlant has zero or more SolarGeneratingUnit.

HAS_WIND_POWER_PLANT: A wind power plant may have wind generating units. Each WindGeneratingUnit has at most one WindPowerPlant. The inverse role is WindPowerPlant.WindGeneratingUnits: each WindPowerPlant has zero or more WindGeneratingUnit.
